---
title: "Example Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [brand, _dashboard.scss]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
brand <- yaml::read_yaml(brand::brand_file())
palette <- brand$color$palette

readable <- function(hex) {
  channels <- strtoi(substring(hex, c(2, 4, 6), c(3, 5, 7)), 16L) / 255
  if (sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * channels) > 0.4) "#1E1512" else "#F2E8DE"
}

tiles <- function(values) {
  cells <- sprintf(
    '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;
       justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;overflow:hidden;min-height:0;
       background:%s;color:%s;border-radius:.375rem;padding:0 .7rem">
       <span>%s</span>
       <span style="font-family:var(--bs-font-monospace);opacity:.75">%s</span>
     </div>',
    values,
    vapply(values, readable, ""),
    names(values),
    values
  )
  knitr::raw_html(sprintf(
    '<div style="display:grid;gap:.4rem;grid-auto-rows:1fr">%s</div>',
    paste(cells, collapse = "")
  ))
}

for_mode <- function(mode) {
  tokens <- setdiff(names(brand$color), "palette")
  values <- vapply(tokens, function(token) {
    value <- brand$color[[token]]
    value <- if (is.list(value)) value[[mode]] else value
    if (value %in% names(palette)) palette[[value]] else value
  }, "")
  tiles(values)
}
```

## Row {height="12%"}

::: card
### Valley Sans sets the headings {style="margin:0"}

Domine sets body text and `CommitMono` sets code. Every colour below is read
out of the same `_brand.yml` that styles this site.
:::

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Light
for_mode("light")
```

```{r}
#| title: Dark
for_mode("dark")
```

```{r}
#| title: Palette
tiles(unlist(palette))
```
